Unsigned lane/destination arithmetic stays within these fixed bounds; row remains signed int64 and relies on the caller's checked complete-row allocation contract.

The publisher writes rows only for tid<Cells, then an unconditional local-space work-group barrier precedes staging. No barrier or collective is inside the divergent row branch; all lanes reach the unchanged post-staging barrier before matrix/subgroup consumers. The row table remains stable through its later validity read and is republished only for the next tile.

Both CPU-only IR arms compile with 662 actual dependencies. Control row load %258 is inside natural K loop 246..279; candidate row load %251 is in block 249 before natural K loop 256..275. The IR shows per-element i16 loads with align 2, not a guaranteed 64-bit transaction.
